## Problem and result

Link the issue (one change = one PR). Describe the concrete trigger, resulting behavior and scope.

## Validation and evidence

Name each single-file check actually run, worker limit and result. List skipped checks and reasons. For evidence, include date, revision, local/live scope and limitations; retain FAIL/BLOCKED findings. For docs-only changes, name link/syntax/diff checks. Disclose material AI assistance and provenance of adapted work.

## Checklist

- [ ] One change = one PR; unrelated changes excluded.
- [ ] Single-file, single-worker tests named above (or docs-only checks and runtime-test skip reason); evidence is honest about unrun checks and local/live scope.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, absolute operator/sandbox paths or private deployment identifiers in changes/evidence.
- [ ] Every contribution commit has DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`); contribution rights and material AI assistance reviewed.

For public-entry-point/CODEOWNERS changes, record here that `@yolo-labs-hq/octocove-maintainers` exists, is visible (not secret) and has explicit repository write access; these are GitHub organisation settings that a maintainer verifies.
